run_forcetorquesensor_demo: run the pybullet forcetorquesensor example to demonstrate joint force and torque readings on a hinge URDF
enable_joint_force_torque_sensor: enable a force/torque sensor on a specific joint index using enableJointForceTorqueSensor
get_joint_state_with_sensor: get the joint state including applied force and torque values via getJointState after enabling the sensor
set_joint_velocity_control: set a joint to velocity control mode with zero target velocity using setJointMotorControl2
load_urdf_and_simulate: load a hinge URDF model into pybullet and step the simulation with configurable gravity
